svg.title: Two heralded attempts, then the T state
svg.desc: Timeline of the heralded T-state kernel with two attempts, on D5's drive and readout lines and the controller link. Each attempt reads D5 out for 300 ns, sends the outcome to the herald function, and plays a pi pulse only if the qubit read 1. After the second attempt, a Y90 pulse and a pi/4 frame shift prepare the T state, and a last readout from 824 ns measures it.
